name: inf-ped-near
note: PO 10-09 "there was a ped close, which the Zombie just ignored". An infected stands with its back to a pedestrian 2.2 m behind it (outside its view cone); the courier is out of range. Look for: it turns, grabs and bites the pedestrian within ~3 s; the pedestrian goes down and turns (no ignoring a body at arm's length).
